c1-2b-001.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | gap | Write one word in each gap: So I'm at the bakery, I ___ ___ in the queue, and this woman suddenly ___ round and hands me her dog. (stand, turn) |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: So I'm at the bakery, I ___ ___ in the queue, and this woman suddenly ___ round and hands me her dog. (stand, turn)
item.why: In a story told in the present, the background is in the present continuous (*I'm standing in the queue*) and the main events in the present simple (*turns, hands*).
item.why_lv: Stāstā tagadnē fons ir Present Continuous (*I'm standing in the queue*), bet *galvenie* notikumi Present Simple (*turns, hands*).

c1-2b-002.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | So this man is walking into a café and he orders a glass of milk.

key.correct: So this man is walking into a café and he orders a glass of milk.
wrong: So I'm sitting on the train, and this man opens a bag of crisps.
We're having dinner when all the lights go out.
Then the waiter looks at him and says, "Are you sure?"

item.why: In a joke or a story told in the present, the main events are in the present simple: *So this man walks into a café and orders…* The background can be continuous (*I'm sitting on the train*).
item.why_lv: Jokā vai stāstā tagadnē *galvenie* notikumi ir Present Simple: *So this* man *walks into a caf*é *and orders*… Fons var būt ilgstošajā formā (*I'm sitting on the train*).
item.correct: So this man is walking into a café and he orders a glass of milk.
wrong: So I'm sitting on the train, and this man opens a bag of crisps.
We're having dinner when all the lights go out.
Then the waiter looks at him and says, "Are you sure?"

c1-2b-003.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | gap | The app ___ to work on my phone. Can you check it? (not / appear) |

item.q: The app ___ to work on my phone. Can you check it? (not / appear)
item.why: *appear* = seem is a state: present simple, *doesn't appear to work*. In the meaning *take part* it can be continuous (*She's appearing in a musical*).
item.why_lv: *appear* = šķist ir stāvoklis: Present Simple, *doesn't appear to work*. Nozīmē piedalīties, uzstāties var būt Continuous forma (*She's appearing in a musical*).

c1-2b-004.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | gap | My sister and her husband ___ their first baby next month. (expect) |

item.q: My sister and her husband ___ their first baby next month. (expect)
item.why: *be expecting a baby* = she is pregnant, always continuous. In the meaning *think something will happen*, *expect* is simple (*I expect it will rain*).
item.why_lv: *be expecting a baby = gaida* bērnu, vienmēr Continuous forma. Nozīmē domāt, ka kaut kas notiks *expect* ir vienkāršajā formā (*I expect it will rain*).
